answer: At payout, each identity stands on its ledge and calls its claim toward the crystal wall. The wall returns one echo per call, recorded against the identity that made it, and every identity backs its call with a 900,000 POA stake. Two identities whose calls return the same echo belong to one operator: both rewards burn, both stakes pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 600,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 1,500,000 POA, and six fakes cost 9,000,000 POA before any payout clears.
